desc: Select ALPHA, the LEFT bulky defensive knight only. Heavy broad symmetrical shoulder pauldrons, stout thick arms and legs, closed ivory angular helmet with short gold central crest and thin cyan V visor. Circular gold chest badge with navy four-point slit emblem, navy waist tabard with gold trim, ordinary ivory armored lower legs. Square gold-edged winding plate attached FLUSH on upper back. Keep the same heavy armor forms. Strict FRONT view.

Select OMEGA, the RIGHT tall slender spear knight only. Narrow graceful silhouette and smaller shoulders compared with Alpha, angular ivory closed helmet with thin cyan V visor, circular chest badge, fitted navy waist armor with long slim gold-edged front tabard. Keep solid neck/shoulder collar but REMOVE flowing cape entirely for separate accessory modeling. Expose plain flush square gold-edged winding plate on upper back. No skirt beyond original split tabard. Strict FRONT view.

Select HARD ALPHA, the LEFT huge defensive knight only. Massive broad hunched shoulder shell armor, angular transformed closed helmet with extended hornlike side fins and violet V visor. Keep this same head as concept; no extra face. Torso has an open hinged ribcage of ivory armor firmly connected to dark inner torso frame, exposing ONE thick vertical GOLD COMPRESSION SPRING in chest only. Gold chest brackets/bolts support it. Strong thick legs with ivory plates and navy thigh gaps, no exposed gears or springs below waist. Symmetric physical body suited for rigging, armor split panels remain firmly attached to joints, not floating. Strict FRONT view.

Select HARD OMEGA, the RIGHT slender halberd knight only. Narrow agile silhouette, ivory swept pointed closed helmet and thin violet V visor, angular gold-edged collar. Open split ivory breastplate reveals ONE narrow VERTICAL GOLD SPRING in chest, supported by navy torso and gold brackets. Keep spring in chest only; ordinary ivory plated legs and navy joint gaps below waist. Remove cape entirely as separate accessory, leave neck collar and flush square upper-back mount. Two ordinary humanoid arms only. Strict FRONT view.
